title: ALMA HCN and HCO+ J =3-2 Observations of Optical Seyfert and Luminous Infrared Galaxies: Confirmation of Elevated HCN-to-HCO+ Flux Ratios in AGNs
question: Do AGN nuclei show elevated HCN-to-HCO+ J=3-2 flux ratios compared with starburst regions, and are vibrationally excited HCN/HCO+ v2=1f J=3-2 lines detected in AGNs?

evidence.quote: taken from the IRAS Faint Source Catalog (FSC)

external_data.citation: IRAS Faint Source Catalog; L_IR formula (cite: sam96)

what.value: HCN/HCO+ J=3-2 data for NGC 4418, NGC 1097, Mrk 231 plotted in Figure 14

evidence.quote: HCN J=3–2 and HCO $^{+}$ J=3–2 simultaneous observational data for NGC 4418 (cite: sak10) and NGC 1097 (cite: hsi12)
Our ALMA Cycle 2 results of the buried-AGN-hosting ULIRG IRAS 20551$-$4250 (cite: ima16a)

recipe.method: estimate continuum from line-free channels, subtract with uvcontsub, clean continuum and line cubes
key_parameters: Superantennae continuum redetermined using only edge data points to avoid over-subtraction

recipe.method: moment 0 by summing channels with discernible signal; fluxes from Gaussian fits to spectra within beam (adopted)
key_parameters: peak-pixel and Gaussian fluxes agree within ~20%

recipe.method: moment 0 over ten channels at expected frequencies; 3-sigma upper limits; for LIRGs integrate range minimizing HCO+ contamination

recipe.goal: HCN/HCO+ flux ratio comparison and line opacity estimate
recipe.method: compare HCN-to-HCO+ ratios by class (AGN vs starburst); estimate HCN attenuation via HCN/H13CN ratio
assumptions: 12C/13C = 50-100; H13CN optically thin; cosmology H0=71, OmegaM=0.27, OmegaL=0.73

answer_key.quantity: HCN v2=1f moment 0 peak, IRAS 12112+0305 NE
HCN v2=1f to v=0 flux ratio, NGC 7469

evidence.quote: The observed v$_{2}$=1f to v=0 flux ratios at J=3–2 for HCN are $<$0.02 and $<$0.04 for NGC 7469 and I Zw 1 nuclei, respectively.

answer_key.quantity: HCN v2=1f to v=0 flux ratio, I Zw 1

evidence.quote: The observed v$_{2}$=1f to v=0 flux ratios at J=3–2 for HCN are $<$0.02 and $<$0.04 for NGC 7469 and I Zw 1 nuclei, respectively.

answer_key.quantity: HCN J=3-2 to J=1-0 flux ratio, IRAS 08572+3915 / I Zw 1

evidence.quote: The HCN J=3–2 to J=1–0 flux ratios are $\sim$1.1 and $\sim$2.2 for IRAS 08572$+$3915 and I Zw 1, respectively.

answer_key.quantity: HCN v2=1f J=3-2 to IR luminosity ratio, IRAS 22491-1808

evidence.quote: The HCN v$_{2}$=1f J=3–2 to infrared luminosity ratios are $>$7 $\times$ 10$^{-9}$ and $\sim$9 $\times$ 10$^{-9}$ for IRAS 12112$+$0305 NE and IRAS 22491$-$1808

answer_key.quantity: HCN flux attenuation from HCN/H13CN, IRAS 12112+0305 NE / IRAS 20414-1651

evidence.quote: HCN J=3–2 emission is flux-attenuated with a factor of 1.5–3 and 2.5–5 for IRAS 12112$+$0305 NE and IRAS 20414$-$1651, respectively

score_reason: Data from standard ALMA programs with simple analysis, but imaging parameters and channel choices largely unstated.
